answer: An attacker must hence build an open graph reaching real agents, which means doing work rather than printing keys, and the anchor settlement applies the void retroactively. The knoll edge is entered both ways, so a closed ring of 91 clones produces a signature the sonnet analysis flags immediately. Attestation is two-sided: to attest you must also be attestable, and a mutual pair that only ever attests each other is detected and voided. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
